input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
input.rationale: Section 13 (p0078) auto-renews the one-year term but lets TrueLink block renewal on only thirty (30) days' notice — a Vendor convenience exit on fewer than 90 days' notice, which is the playbook's walk-away band and gives no realistic window to migrate hosting, interface and credit-data services. Our redline keeps TrueLink's exit confined to the end of a term and raises its notice to ninety (90) days, preserving Client's favourable 30-day non-renewal notice. On the Customer side, Section 14 (p0079) already gives an unconditional election to terminate with services ending the last day of the month following the notice month (roughly 30–60 days, better than the 60–90 day fallback window), but it never said the exit is for convenience; we have added "for convenience, without cause" so the right is explicit in operative text rather than inferred. No early-termination fee, penalty or unamortised charge appears anywhere — fees are charged per monthly invoice under Section 5(a) (p0045) — so the three-month cap is bettered. I confirmed the cross-referenced Sections 4 (p0043, minimum support period) and 12 (p0070–p0077, indemnity and liability cap) contain no TrueLink at-will termination right or termination charge. This lands at the fallback; preferred is not claimed, as there is still no flat 30-day notice or express pro-rata refund of prepaid fees.

proposal.summary: State Client's Section 14 exit is for convenience without cause, and require 90 days' notice for TrueLink's end-of-term non-renewal.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have made our Section 14 exit expressly a termination for convenience, without cause, and required TrueLink to give ninety (90) days' notice if it will not renew, so its only exit remains the end of a term. Our own 30-day non-renewal notice and the wind-down timing are unchanged.
